# Knowledge Network

> The author's personal website: a hand-maintained index of essays,
> interactive experiments, media servers, art, and data analysis —
> centred on space, time, perception, and scientific vision, often
> approached through contested questions.

Home: https://followorbounce.github.io/

## Sections

- Aerospace — spaceflight history and engineering. Index: https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/
  - Waves — sound, light, seismic motion, and matter waves: https://followorbounce.github.io/waves
- Maya Basics — Maya calendrical systems. Index: https://followorbounce.github.io/Maya-Calendar/
- Machinery — heavy machinery explained through engineering, physics, and mathematics. Index: https://followorbounce.github.io/machinery/
- Radio & Electronics — Radio Communications (frequency, modulation, propagation, spacecraft links, spectrum management): https://followorbounce.github.io/radio-communications. Also media servers, experiments and observations (planned).
- Philosophy — nature of time, consciousness, reality and perception, free will, ethics (planned).
- Personal — notes, travel stories, ideas, books and references, useful tools, archive (planned).

- Different Vision trainings: https://designdivinefuture.wordpress.com/
